propositions: Comment identity must be determined by a persistent HLC-timestamp → Jira-comment-ID map rather than normalized body equality, to prevent collisions on duplicate or edited text
The returned comment ID from add_comment must be captured at both creation and update enactment sites and persisted write-ahead via record_comment_id
Outbound and inbound comment sync must each maintain separate authoritative identity sources (map for outbound, jira_comment_id for inbound) without cross-direction competition
Comment sync must be append-only: new comments created and mirrored once, with edits and deletes skipped in both directions

Outbound comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-before-encode ordering to support ADF on Cloud and wiki on DC, with the dedup key codec migrated from IdentityCodec to the real codec
The comment-ID map must be change-gated with no per-pass churn and remain durable across crashes via immediate save on successful add_comment return
